headerDisplay: Shows Brother laser and inkjet printers in HomeKit: printing state, problems, and toner or ink levels. SNMP must be on in the printer's web page (Network > Protocol).

host.title: IP address or hostname
host.description: Required. Printers without an address are ignored.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: Optional; filled in by Search or Test connection above. Keeps this printer in Home (room, automations, notifications) when you rename it or its address changes.

protocol.title: Read the printer over

oneOf.title: SNMP (most detail: exact toner %, drum and parts, page count)
SNMP, or IPP (AirPrint) when SNMP doesn't answer

protocol.description: IPP works with SNMP turned off, but gives less: toner / ink % and paper trays, but no drum, parts, page count, serial number or status text, and on some Brother printers toner only as "some remaining", without a %.

ippUrl.title: IPP address
ippUrl.description: Leave empty for ipp://<address>:631/ipp/print, which Brother printers use. ipps:// for an encrypted connection.

ippAllowSelfSigned.title: Accept the printer's self-signed certificate (ipps://)
ippAllowSelfSigned.description: Brother printers' own certificates are self-signed, so ipps:// fails without this. With it on, the connection is encrypted but not verified: another device on your network could pose as the printer. ipp:// doesn't need it.

v3User.title: SNMPv3 user name
v3User.description: As set in the printer's web page: Network > Protocol > SNMP.

v3AuthProtocol.title: SNMPv3 authentication
v3AuthProtocol.description: None also needs encryption set to None.

v3Context.title: SNMPv3 context name
v3Context.description: Leave empty unless one is set in the printer's SNMPv3 settings.

lowTonerThreshold.title: Toner / ink low at (%)
lowTonerThreshold.description: On color printers, the battery shows the lowest color and turns low when any color reaches this.

lowTonerSensor.title: Low toner sensor
lowTonerSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that opens when toner or ink is low, so Home notifies "Toner Low opened" instead of "battery is low". Turn on notifications for it in the Home app.

lowDrumThreshold.title: Drum and parts low at (%)
lowDrumThreshold.description: Logs a warning when the drum, belt, fuser, laser unit, paper feed kit, waste ink or toner box, developer or maintenance kit reaches this.

tonerTile.title: Show toner / ink % on tiles
tonerTile.description: Adds a sensor whose value is the level: one for a mono printer, one per color for a color printer. HomeKit has no plain % sensor, so these are light sensors (the level in lux), or humidity sensors for Eve history, which Home then counts as the room's humidity.

tileType.title: Show the tiles as (unset: light sensors, or humidity with Eve history on)

oneOf.title: Light sensors (the level in lux; few rooms have another one)
Humidity sensors (% — needed for Eve history; Home counts them as the room's humidity)

printingSensor.title: Show printing as

oneOf.title: An occupancy sensor (Detected while printing; the room shows as occupied then)

printingSensor.description: The printer's own tile. Changing it gives the printer a new tile in Home: automations on the old one need setting up again.

maintenanceSensor.title: Maintenance sensor
maintenanceSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that opens when the drum or another part (belt, fuser, laser unit, paper feed kit, waste ink or toner box, developer, maintenance kit) reaches the parts threshold, so Home can notify it.

paperSensor.title: Out of paper sensor
paperSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that opens when a tray is out of paper, so Home notifies "Printer Out of Paper opened". The Problem sensor opens for this too.

paperTraySensors.title: A sensor for each paper tray
paperTraySensors.description: Adds one contact sensor per paper tray ("Tray 1", "Tray 2"…) that opens when that tray is empty. Bypass and manual trays, often empty on purpose, get none. The trays are then read on every poll.

onlineSensor.title: Offline sensor
onlineSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor "Offline" that opens when the printer stops answering, for notifications and automations such as turning off its smart plug. Unlike the other sensors it doesn't show No Response when the printer is offline.

eveHistory.title: Eve history of the toner / ink level
eveHistory.description: Shows a graph of the level over about 60 days in the Eve app, on the toner / ink tiles (turn those on too, and show them as humidity sensors). On a color printer each tile shows the lowest color. The page count also shows only in Eve, not in Apple's Home app. The first time, Homebridge takes a few seconds longer to start.

faultSensor.title: Problem sensor
faultSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that opens on a jam, open cover, empty tray or other error, so Home can show and notify it.
